description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerHandler class, which manages runtime lifecycle events and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes nested notification class, lifecycle management methods, and references to external interfaces and classes.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Manages runtime lifecycle events, notifications, and interactions with the runtime manager within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the IRuntimeManager notification interface to handle runtime events such as start, termination, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts or runs an application with specified parameters and target state.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the application instance identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the application instance and sets its lifecycle state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the specified application instance.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON data events related to runtime.
